author: nflaig
content:
I don't think lodestar is really affected by removing the signature, we only verified it during gossip validation and import, the payload root check should replace this without any issues

dropping the signature should be mostly relevant for clients that checked it before knowing the block, since in that case you cannot check the payload root, but either way, that signature check is easy to abuse since you just need a few builders or validators to work around it
